notes.title: Down the Rabbit Hole's First Patch is Live!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Down the Rabbit Hole 1.01[/b][/h3]
[b]
If you haven't taken the plunge down the rabbit hole, now's a great time to discover why so many people are raving about their VR adventure through Wonderland. This patch includes:[/b]
[list]
[*]The addition of multiple save slots 
[*]Lots of bug fixes
[*]Puzzles that were written in English now have pictures
[*]Subtitles for seven new languages:
[list]
[*]Chinese
[*]Japanese
[*]Korean
[*]Italian
[*]Portuguese (Brazil)
[*]Spanish (Latin America)
[*]French (Canada)
[/list]
[/list]
